qa_pairs.question: What job parameters can be configured when submitting an interactive application on the Open OnDemand platform?
qa_pairs.answer: When submitting an interactive application on Open OnDemand, users can choose parameters such as the length of the job in hours, the number of cores, the amount of memory to allocate (in GB), and specific GPU resources.

qa_pairs.question: What are the specifications of the h100_1.10 Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) profile available for interactive applications in Open OnDemand?
qa_pairs.answer: The h100_1.10 Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) profile, which is currently the only one available, provides 10GB of memory and 1/8 of the compute power of a full NVIDIA H100 GPU.
